title: ProGuard/R8 对 dex、类加载、JIT 与运行时内存的影响
key_conclusions: R8 can reduce runtime memory indirectly by shrinking classes, methods, dex mappings, class metadata, and initialization paths.
Broad keep rules cap memory wins because unused classes still remain loadable and may be duplicated across processes.
Dex size reduction must be validated on device with class loading, maps/showmap, meminfo, startup traces, and correctness tests.
In multi-process apps, every process needs its own class-loading and JIT validation because runtime costs are partly duplicated.
shallow_points: The article does not include a real before/after APK Analyzer report.
It does not validate ART oat/vdex/JIT behavior against a specific Android version.
It does not include a real broad-keep cleanup case with measured memory deltas.
It does not compare R8 effects with Baseline Profile effects on startup memory.
discovered_connections: Day 71's duplicate per-process cost model shows why R8 savings matter more when the same feature loads classes in multiple processes.
Day 69's startup peak model is required to prove dex/class changes affect first-draw memory rather than only APK size.
Day 68's cross-validation applies to dex/oat/vdex mappings through maps, showmap, meminfo, and trace agreement.
Day 73 should convert these per-topic methods into one observation, attribution, intervention, validation loop.
suggest_future_topics: Day 73 should focus on a global memory optimization methodology: observe, attribute, intervene, and validate.
A future appendix should include an R8 before/after worksheet with APK Analyzer, maps, meminfo, and startup trace fields.
A future lab should compare R8 shrink, Baseline Profiles, and lazy initialization on the same app.
A future checklist should classify keep rules by reflection, serialization, JNI, resource lookup, and SDK constraints.
knowledge_gaps: Need real APK Analyzer reports and device traces before and after R8 changes.
Need Android-version-specific evidence for oat/vdex/JIT/profile behavior.

Need comparison between R8 optimization and Baseline Profile optimization for memory and startup latency.
